periodicity: N=34 p=13 q=46   (v_{n+p} = v_n + q for all n >= N)
p*gamma - q*n for n = N .. N+p-1: 35 41 34 40 33 39 32 38 44 37 43 36 42
so gamma(n) = ceil((46 n + 32) / 13) for all n >= N; exceptions below N: 2(-1) 3(-1) 4(-1) 5(-1) 7(-1) 9(-1) 16(-1) 18(-1)
